changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Field') BEGIN create table [dbo].[Field]( [ID] bigint identity not null, AssetID bigint sparse, IntersectID int sparse, IssueID int sparse, FieldTypeID int not null, ObjectType varchar(50) null, ObjectID int null, [Value] nvarchar(max) null, FormattedValue nvarchar(max) null, UpdatedBy int constraint [DF_Field_UpdatedBy] default(0) not null, UpdatedOn datetime constraint [DF_Field_UpdatedOn] default(getutcdate()) not null, constraint PK_Field primary key clustered ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Field_FieldType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Field] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Field_FieldType] FOREIGN KEY([FieldTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[FieldType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Field] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Field_FieldType] END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
if exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'UQ_Field_ID') begin ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FieldJsonProperty] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_FieldJsonProperty_Field]; drop index UQ_Field_ID ON [dbo].[Field]; end
if exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Field_FieldTypeID_Include') begin drop index IX_Field_FieldTypeID_Include ON [dbo].[Field] end
if exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Field_FieldTypeID_Include_date') begin drop index IX_Field_FieldTypeID_Include_date ON [dbo].[Field] end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Field_FieldType_Include') begin create nonclustered index IX_Field_FieldType_Include ON [dbo].[Field] ( [FieldTypeID] ASC ) INCLUDE(FormattedValue, [Value], UpdatedOn) end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Field_FieldTypeID_Include_Ids') begin create nonclustered index [IX_Field_FieldTypeID_Include_Ids] ON [dbo].[Field] ( [FieldTypeID] ASC ) INCLUDE([AssetID],[IntersectID],[IssueID]) end
declare @ids table (ID bigint)
insert into @ids select max(ID) as MaxID from Field where AssetID is not null group by FieldTypeID, AssetID having count(1) > 1
delete f from Field f inner join ( select FieldTypeID, AssetID from Field where AssetID is not null group by FieldTypeID, AssetID having count(1) > 1 ) g on g.AssetID = f.AssetID and g.FieldTypeID = f.FieldTypeID where f.ID not in (select ID from @ids);
if exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'IX_Field_FieldTypeIDAssetID_Include') begin drop index [IX_Field_FieldTypeIDAssetID_Include] ON [dbo].[Field] end
if exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'IX_Field_Asset_FieldType') begin DROP INDEX [IX_Field_Asset_FieldType] ON [dbo].[Field] end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'IX_Field_FieldType_Asset') begin create unique nonclustered index IX_Field_FieldType_Asset on [dbo].[Field] ( [FieldTypeID] ASC, [AssetID] ASC ) include (FormattedValue, [Value]) where (FieldTypeID is not null and AssetID is not null) end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'IX_Field_AssetID') begin create nonclustered index [IX_Field_AssetID] ON [dbo].[Field] ([AssetID] ASC) end
delete @ids;
insert into @ids select max(ID) as MaxID from Field where IntersectID is not null group by FieldTypeID, IntersectID having count(1) > 1
delete f from Field f inner join ( select FieldTypeID, IntersectID from Field where IntersectID is not null group by FieldTypeID, IntersectID having count(1) > 1 ) g on g.IntersectID = f.IntersectID and g.FieldTypeID = f.FieldTypeID where f.ID not in (select ID from @ids);
if exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'IX_Field_FieldTypeIdIntersectID') begin drop index [IX_Field_FieldTypeIdIntersectID] on [dbo].[Field] end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'IX_Field_Intersect_FieldType') begin create unique nonclustered index [IX_Field_Intersect_FieldType] on [dbo].[Field] ( IntersectID asc, FieldTypeID asc ) include ([Value], FormattedValue) where IntersectID is not null and FieldTypeID is not null end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'IX_Field_IntersectID') begin create nonclustered index [IX_Field_IntersectID] ON [dbo].[Field] ([IntersectID] ASC) end
delete @ids;
insert into @ids select max(ID) as MaxID from Field where IssueID is not null group by FieldTypeID, IssueID having count(1) > 1
delete f from Field f inner join ( select FieldTypeID, IssueID from Field where IssueID is not null group by FieldTypeID, IssueID having count(1) > 1 ) g on g.IssueID = f.IssueID and g.FieldTypeID = f.FieldTypeID where f.ID not in (select ID from @ids);
if exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'IX_Field_FieldTypeIdIssueID') begin drop index [IX_Field_FieldTypeIdIssueID] on [dbo].[Field] end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'IX_Field_Issue_FieldType') begin create unique nonclustered index IX_Field_Issue_FieldType on [dbo].[Field] ( [IssueID] asc, [FieldTypeID] asc ) include ([Value], FormattedValue) where IssueID is not null and FieldTypeID is not null end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'IX_Field_IssueID') begin create nonclustered index [IX_Field_IssueID] ON [dbo].[Field] ([IssueID] ASC) end

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS ( select 1 from [sys].[fulltext_indexes] i inner join [sys].[objects] o on o.object_id = i.object_id and o.Name = 'Field' ) BEGIN CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX ON dbo.Field(Value, FormattedValue) KEY INDEX PK_Field ON fullTextCatalog END
